title: MCP tool-call analytics counts drop because response_status now defaults to success
symptoms: Tool-call timeseries totals are lower than before 2026-10-28
Failed and cached MCP calls no longer appear in analytics results
cause: The timeseries endpoints for account, portal and server now take a response_status parameter that defaults to success. Previously counts included failed and cached calls. Invalid or empty values return 400.
fix: Pass response_status=all to get the old all-status counts, or choose error or cached to count one status.
